title: Path Diagnostic V1 (what GET /api/environment answers)
$comment: Written against the payload the product actually emitted on 2026-10-08, captured by driving design_lab.http_service.make_server over a real socket (see design-lab/scripts/verify_route_payload_contracts.py). The emitter is ProjectPaths.describe() at src/design_lab/runtime/paths.py:212. This schema deliberately does not tidy anything up: `status` is the single literal describe() ever writes, the four `roots` keys are the four categories in the source, and `tools.*.path` is allowed to be an empty string because tool_bindings() reports DECLARED_VALUE_INVALID for a declared value that is blank rather than dropping the entry. shared_inputs and tools keys are machine-declared names, so they are pattern-free additionalProperties maps, not enums.

status.description: The only verdict describe() produces: reaching this payload at all means the policy resolved, because every failure raises PathPolicyError instead.

project_local_root.description: Which input won the resolution of the local root, in the precedence order resolve_paths() implements.

status.description: The diagnostic never traverses an external root, so a shared input is reported as declared and nothing more.
The five states tool_bindings() can assign. BOUND is granted only when the path sits inside a declared shared-input root and is an existing file.
